@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This door is a______c. All you need to do is walk near it, and it will open by itself.
= automatic
~詞義 automatic（adj.）自動的
~原文 This door is automatic. All you need to do is walk near it, and it will open by itself.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: They sell more than 20 different f______rs of ice cream; my personal favorite is vanilla.
= flavors
~詞義 flavor（n.）口味
~原文 They sell more than 20 different flavors of ice cream; my personal favorite is vanilla.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The domestic price of f______l is closely related to the international price of oil. When there is a war in an oil-exporting country, the price usually goes up.
= fuel
~詞義 fuel（n.）燃料
~原文 The domestic price of fuel is closely related to the international price of oil. When there is a war in an oil-exporting country, the price usually goes up.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You can tell from the similar style of these trousers that they all come from the same ______ (design).
= designer
~詞義 designer（n.）設計師
~原文 You can tell from the similar style of these trousers that they all come from the same designer.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our field trip was to see an ______ (exhibit) of ancient Chinese art at the National Palace Museum.
= exhibition
~詞義 exhibition（n.）展覽
~原文 Our field trip was to see an exhibition of ancient Chinese art at the National Palace Museum.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The inner part of this wallet is made of ______, so it is soft but sturdy.
A: quotation
B: humidity
C: leather
D: freedom
= C
~詞義 leather（n.）皮革
~原文 The inner part of this wallet is made of leather, so it is soft but sturdy.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The carpenter made the table from ______ wood, making sure that it would last for years.
A: daily
B: bald
C: liberal
D: solid
= D
~詞義 solid（adj.）堅固的;實心的
~原文 The carpenter made the table from solid wood, making sure that it would last for years.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The old friends were ______ up in conversation and didn't notice the time passing.
A: wrapped
B: folded
C: quoted
D: spoiled
= A
~詞義 wrap（v.）專心於(be wrapped up in)
~原文 The old friends were wrapped up in conversation and didn't notice the time passing.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When Melody tried to explain what had happened, her friends kept ______ her.
A: resisting
B: interrupting
C: exhibiting
D: consisting
= B
~詞義 interrupt（v.）打斷
~原文 When Melody tried to explain what had happened, her friends kept interrupting her.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: James needs just one more science ______ to complete his degree requirements.
A: entry
B: credit
C: restriction
D: feather
= B
~詞義 credit（n.）學分
~原文 James needs just one more science credit to complete his degree requirements.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: moist
B: restrict
C: interruption
D: resistance
E: spoil
F: might

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Alex put his smartphone on silent mode so that he could watch the movie without ______.
= C
~詞義 interruption（n.）中斷
~原文 Alex put his smartphone on silent mode so that he could watch the movie without interruption.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The entire family pushed the car with all their ______ until it finally started moving.
= F
~詞義 might（n.）力量
~原文 The entire family pushed the car with all their might until it finally started moving.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Parents who give their children too much money are likely to ______ them.
= E
~詞義 spoil（v.）寵壞
~原文 Parents who give their children too much money are likely to spoil them.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Because of an increase in the number of gun crimes, the government has passed a new law to ______ the sale of guns.
= B
~詞義 restrict（v.）限制
~原文 Because of an increase in the number of gun crimes, the government has passed a new law to restrict the sale of guns.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The gardener waters the plants every morning to keep the soil ______.
= A
~詞義 moist（adj.）潮濕的
~原文 The gardener waters the plants every morning to keep the soil moist.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: mission
B: outer
C: bold
D: apart
E: moisture
F: committee

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: To find out which planets may be suitable for human beings to live on in the future, much research has been conducted on ______ space.
= B
~詞義 outer（adj.）外部的
~原文 To find out which planets may be suitable for human beings to live on in the future, much research has been conducted on outer space.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: A(n) ______ was set up to investigate the terrible incident.
= F
~詞義 committee（n.）委員會
~原文 A(n) committee was set up to investigate the terrible incident.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ben made a(n) ______ decision to drop out of school and start a business.
= C
~詞義 bold（adj.）大膽的
~原文 Ben made a(n) bold decision to drop out of school and start a business.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The army's ______ was to destroy all the buildings in the area immediately.
= A
~詞義 mission（n.）任務
~原文 The army's mission was to destroy all the buildings in the area immediately.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: According to the doctor, ______ is important for keeping your skin healthy. Without it, your skin may become dry and itchy.
= E
~詞義 moisture（n.）濕氣;潮濕
~原文 According to the doctor, moisture is important for keeping your skin healthy. Without it, your skin may become dry and itchy.
